rationale: test/harness/rt_allocation_probe.{hpp,cpp} (matched by the test/harness/** selector) become one-line forwarders to tools/testing/rt_allocation_probe, which the SDK now exports as Pulp::rt-allocation-probe. The probe counts heap allocations in DSP tests; it is not a visual-proof, screenshot, golden, capture or render surface. No design-import, Chromium, rendering or packaging authority moves.
